jobs.title: SAP Security Officer (DoD) - Onsite, Active Secret Clearance
jobs.description: RTX is seeking an experienced Alternate Contractor SAP Security Officer (ACSSO) in McKinney, TX to support SAP programs, enforce DoD/IC security requirements, and oversee program-specific documentation and inspections. jobs.description:
Allied Universal, North America’s leading security and facility services company, is seeking a Security Officer Vehicle Patrol Driver in McKinney, TX. jobs.title: Lead Security Officer
jobs.description:
Serrato Corp. in McKinney, Texas, is seeking a Safety/Security/Transportation Manager to oversee planning and implementation of safety programs. The role involves managing staff, ensuring security, and developing safety procedures. A minimum of three years in security or law enforcement and an Associate's Degree are required, with a preference for a Bachelor's in a related field.

The successful candidate will enjoy benefits including health insurance, paid holidays, and a 401(k) plan. Join a team dedicated to the safety and well-being of students and staff!
